newsitem.title: UK: Arjo Wiggins says H1 turnover 1.64 bln stg.
newsitem.headline: Arjo Wiggins says H1 turnover 1.64 bln stg.

text.p: Paper manufacturer Arjo Wiggins-Appleton said on Friday its turnover in the six months to June 30, 1997 declined to 1.64 billion stg from 1.85 billion in the previous year.
The group said its 1997 figures have been affected by strengthening of sterling.

The company is due to announce its interim results on September 11 but must announce its turnover figures within 40 days after completion of every quarter according to rules of Paris Stock Exchange where it is listed as well.
The company notched a turnover of 816 million stg, up from 961.7 million, in the first quarter and another 825.9 million, against 894.9 million in 1996, in the second quarter.
The company said at constant exchange rates, turnover for the second quarter represented an increase of 4.3 percent over the same period last year.
On the same basis, turnover for the six-month period was almost unchanged as opposed to a 11.6 percent decline.
